title: Der Hölle Rache
subtitle: The Queen of the Night's aria from Die Zauberflöte, Act 2

passages.label: Der Hölle Rache kocht in meinem Herzen
Fühlt nicht durch dich Sarastro Todesschmerzen
wenn nicht durch dich Sarastro wird erblassen

licences.source: W. A. Mozart, Die Zauberflöte, K. 620 (1791), No. 14, aria

licences.notes: Check the engraver's licence before distributing. The voice part is renamed (the engraving labels it Flute) and the singer label above bar 2 dropped. Five syllable markings corrected (Sarastro / Todesschmerzen in bars 13 and 15, ah in bar 39, zertrümmert in bar 57, erblassen in bars 86–87). The coloratura of bars 69–79 is underlaid on the one word Ban—de, as in the published scores; the engraving's two ‘ah’ restarts inside it (bars 74 and 76) are removed.
